name: apple-foundation-evals
description: Run Apple Foundation Models evaluations on your Mac and inspect real session traces inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: On-device Apple model evals and traces
interface.longDescription: Create reusable evaluation suites, run Apple's on-device Foundation Models, compare results, and inspect the actual session transcript in an embedded workspace. Runs and suites stay in a separate local plugin store. Requires macOS 27+, Apple Intelligence, Node.js 22+, and Xcode 27 for the first native build. Intents and remote model providers are excluded.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate Apple's on-device model against these prompts and expected answers
Compare two evaluation runs and inspect their session traces
